{{Quote|Twilight, this is Skywalker. Rendezvous in the south landing bay immediately for evacuation.''"<br />"''Acknowledged, General. On my way.|Anakin Skywalker and the trooper|audio=OnMyWay-DotD.flac|<ref name="dotd" />}}
A '''clone trooper pilot''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] went missing during a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] was one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who accompanied Skywalker to [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] to which the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had been tracked. During [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|the mission]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was the only one to stay in the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] while the others infiltrated the station. After rescuing R2-D2, Skywalker contacted the trooper, ordering him to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the ''Twilight'' to a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] for evacuation. In the hangar, the clone joined the rescue team in a firefight with Confederate forces. Later, he piloted the ''Twilight'' away from Skytop Station.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sir!|The clone pilot to Anakin Skywalker|audio=Sir-DotD.flac|<ref name="dotd" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="db" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="dotd" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Downfall of a Droid Date">{{TCWdates|106}}</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], went missing during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="doad">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> Skywalker, along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the Jedi Knight's replacement astromech [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], eventually [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|tracked]] R2-D2 to [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]<ref name="dotd" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]].<ref name="oeg:s1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]], wearing standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]], was one of the clones who accompanied Skywalker on the mission to rescue the astromech droid. Using Skywalker's [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], the team approached the listening post, and while the rest of the group skydived to the station, the clone remained on the ''Twilight'' to evacuate the rescue team when the mission had been completed.<ref name="dotd" />

[[File:TwilightClonePilot-DotD.png|thumb|left|220px|The clone pilot at the ''Twilight''{{'s}} helm]]
Later, when Skywalker had successfully rescued R2-D2, he contacted the clone trooper and ordered him to pilot the ''Twilight'' into the south [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] for an evacuation. Upon landing in the docking bay, the clone met with Skywalker, CT-7567 and [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]. As the group attempted to leave the docking bay to search for Tano, who had engaged Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], R3-S6, who was revealed to be a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] droid, sealed all exits and activated several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] hanging from the ceiling. When the droids opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on Skywalker and the clones, the clone pilot and the rest of the team were forced to take cover. During the firefight, Skywalker ordered CT-7567 to activate the explosives that the clones had planted in the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room of the station. As Tano rejoined the group and R2-D2 managed to open the hangar door outside the listening post, the group prepared to leave the station. The clone trooper then piloted the ''Twilight'' from Skytop Station before it was destroyed.<ref name="dotd" />

==Personality and traits==
The clone trooper was able to pilot a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and he was trusted enough to fly General Skywalker's personal freighter, the ''Twilight.'' During the mission to Skytop Station, when Skywalker ordered the clone trooper to land in the south landing bay, he obeyed the command.<ref name="dotd" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper pilot was introduced in "[[Duel of the Droids]],"<ref name="dotd" /> the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. In the episode, which aired on [[November 14]], [[2008]], he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode007.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duel of the Droids}}</ref>
